title: 'Tis Almost Time for the Lord to Come

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Db/F]'Tis almost time for the Lord [Bbm]to come, I hear [Ab7]the people say;
[Ab7]The stars of heavenare [Db/F]growing dim, It must be the breaking of the day.
[Db/Ab]O it must be the breaking [Ebm/Bb]of the day! O it must be [Bbm]the breaking of the day!
[Bbm]The night is [Db]almost gone, The day is coming on;

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Db/Ab]O it must be the breaking [Ab]of the day!
[Ab]O it must be the [Db/Ab]breaking of the day!
[Ebm/Bb]O it must be [Bbm]the breaking of the day!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Bbm]To look [Db]for the breaking of the day.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [Bbm]To be ready [Db]for the breaking of the day.
